Butane is blended with propane and used as LPG fuel.
Ethylene is used for fruit ripening and fruit preservation.
Acetylene is used in oxy-acetylene welding and cutting of metals.
Ethyl alcohol is used in alcoholic drinks, tinctures, solvents, perfumes, and as a fuel.
Isopropyl alcohol is used in hand sanitizers, disinfectants, and sterilizing surfaces.
Acetone is used in making varnish, artificial silk, synthetic rubber, and some medicines.
Acetic acid is used as vinegar and in making sauces and jellies.
Benzene is used as a solvent and in dry cleaning.
Phenol is used in carbolic soap, insecticides, and Bakelite.
Ether is used as an anesthetic, solvent, and coolant.
Gasoline is flammable, explosive, and dangerous.
